gear_captions: Insulated cable clamp — Temporarily isolates a damaged charged cable.
Folded rescue sling — Seats a stranded lift passenger for a controlled manual lowering.
Charge tile — Carries one household's evening charge allotment; the inset goes dark when exhausted.
Sail tension jack — Tightens a sail line without cutting off the neighboring roof's airflow.
Insulated oven paddle — Moves a hot bread tray while shielding the cook's hand.
Wind-share vane — Shows whether a roof is blocking its neighbor's prevailing wind; no numbers or dial text.
Root release fork — Lifts roots off a rail without chopping the tree's feeder network.
Rail clinic case — Keeps bandages and heat dressings dry on orchard rounds; no medical insignia needed.
Slag scoop — Transfers cooled fertile slag to tree beds; its broad rim makes the direction of pouring obvious.
Paper lifting paddle — Slides under a sodden document bundle without tearing it.
Portable drying press — Keeps a rescued bundle flat between absorbent boards.
Drain whistle — Mimics the drain lung's blockage call to draw it away from a shelf without harming it.
Brake wedge — Seats under a freight wheel to arrest an uncontrolled cart.
Route judge's paddle — Gives an unmistakable stop signal at the blind turn.
Rhythm striker — Taps a steady beat into the track to lure a spring ram off a brake strip.
Damping mallet — Settles a ringing bell without cracking its lip.
Pipe key — Turns the bath pump's square valve stem; the jaw shape visibly matches the job.
Quiet collar — Clamps around a vibrating pipe to reduce the sound that agitates a hound.
Folding level frame — Checks whether a shifted landing is safe; attached weight is part of the same tool, not a separate card item.
Step jack — Raises one stair block so neighbors can reset its height.
Route bridge plank — Spans a small new foundation gap and locks to matching step sockets.
Wind ladle — Samples wind direction and catches the first rain to tell the cook when to cover the ovens.
Folded lee screen — Opens into a quiet windbreak to settle a cloud bison; show only the folded carried state.
Mill brake shoe — Seats against the rotor rim to stop the mill before a storm tears its sail.
Reed shear — Cuts a mature reed at one clean joint without shredding its living root.
Dormancy jar — Keeps one root cutting cool and dormant during transport; no visible specimen or extra inner jars.
Heat shutter — Blocks radiant heat while a gardener closes a forced-growth furnace; a practical barrier, not an ornate weapon shield.
